name: Text
usage: Secondary text, IDs and paths (`mono`), amounts and times (`numeric`), truncation, group headings (`overline`)

props.name: weight
props.description:
Font weight step: `regular` for body text, `medium` for emphasis, `semibold` for labels, small headings,
figures and key points.

props.name: tone
props.description:
Tone: `primary` for main text, `secondary` for supporting text, `tertiary` for faint hints; the others are
semantic colors.

props.name: mono
props.description: Monospace font: IDs, code, API names, paths.

props.name: numeric
props.description: Tabular numbers (without changing the font), so that amounts, quantities and times line up vertically.

props.name: truncate
props.description: Truncates overflowing text: `true` for a single line, a number for the maximum number of lines.

props.name: overline
props.description: Overline style for group headings (small, secondary color, wider letter spacing).

props.name: as
props.description: HTML element to render: `p` for paragraphs, `label` for form labels.

props.name: htmlFor
props.description: ID of the associated form control when `as="label"`.

props.name: title
props.description: Full text shown on mouse hover (often used together with `truncate`).

examples.name: Basic
examples.title: Basic usage
examples.description: Body text, secondary descriptions and faint hints.

examples.name: MonoAndNumeric
examples.title: Codes, paths and numbers
examples.description: Codes and paths use the monospace font; amounts, quantities and times use tabular numbers to align vertically.

examples.name: Truncate
examples.title: Truncate
examples.description: Truncated to one line; the full text is shown on hover.
